answer: A yarrow patch heals only the ground it grows on, so credit cannot be transplanted between plots. Identity needs two holders outside its own tundra to countersign its claim, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n separate vouchers instead of one crew. Every claim is priced by rank: the k-th filing costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still needing unrelated guarantors. A quartz audit replays a random claim each epoch, and an unconfirmed claim forfeits its bond, which cannot be pooled or resold.
